auth.title: Sign in
auth.lede: Enter your email. We send a link — no password to remember.
auth.sent: Link sent. Check your inbox — it expires in an hour.
auth.error: That failed to send. Try again in a moment.
auth.callbackError: That link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
auth.rateLimited: Too many links requested. Supabase caps sends to a few per hour until you configure SMTP. Wait an hour, or connect a real email service.
auth.signInLede: The address you signed up with. We send a link, not a password.
auth.openOnThisDevice: Open the link on this device — it is the one holding the key.
auth.noRecordBody: This address is signed in, but no coach has added you yet. If you have just arrived, enter the invite code you were sent.

shell.messagingSoon: Messaging is in development. Until it ships, WhatsApp stays where it is.
shell.subtitle: {clients, plural, =0 {Nobody needs you} =1 {1 client needs you} other {# clients need you}} · {checkins, plural, =0 {no check-ins to review} =1 {1 check-in to review} other {# check-ins to review}}

roster.title: Roster
roster.emptyAction: Invite your first client with a code — she signs herself up.

programmes.title: Programmes
programmes.emptyAction: Create a block, write its first week, then duplicate it.
programmes.assigned: {count, plural, =0 {assigned to nobody} =1 {assigned to 1 client} other {assigned to # clients}}
programmes.notPushed: Never pushed — invisible to the client

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.lede: Two fields, once. Your name goes on the programmes you send.
welcome.name: Full name
welcome.notAllowed: This address is not allowed to open a coach account.
welcome.notAllowedBody: Masse is invite-only. If you are a client, your coach sends you an invite code — that is the way in.

toolbar.addClientHint: “Add client” sends an invite code and waits for their onboarding

detail.pickClient: Pick a client from the list.
detail.cycleOn: Cycle tracking and phase levers are available for this client.
detail.cycleOff: Cycle tracking is not enabled for this client.

invite.title: Invite a client
invite.pending: {count, plural, =0 {No invitations pending} =1 {1 invitation pending} other {# invitations pending}}
invite.lede: We generate a code. Send it to her on WhatsApp; she signs herself up and her record appears here.
invite.askCycleHint: She decides for herself at step 7. Without this, the step is not even shown.
invite.shareHint: One use only. It dies after 14 days, or the moment she signs up.

prose.sleep: {under, plural, =0 {No nights} =1 {1 night} other {# nights}} under {target}, averaging {avg}.
prose.sleepNoTarget: Averaging {avg} over {nights, plural, =1 {1 night entered} other {# nights entered}}.
prose.lutealTrim: Luteal load is already trimmed {pct}% — trim a set before you add one.

record.title: File
record.name: Name
record.fileNote: Nothing here is derived — it is the notes app you keep beside the product today, inside it instead. Only you and {first} can read it.

onboarding.codeLede: Your coach sent it to you. It works once.
onboarding.codeBad: That code is not valid. Check it, or ask your coach for a new one.
onboarding.goalLede: One only. It steers every session.
onboarding.injuriesLede: What to work around. One per line, leave empty if none.
onboarding.cycleLede: Optional, and revocable at any time.
onboarding.cyclePromise: If you turn it on, only your period start date and cycle length are stored — in Europe. Your symptom notes never leave your phone: there is no table to hold them. Your coach sees a phase and an adapted load, never a symptom.
onboarding.summaryLede: Check it, then create your account. Your first week is waiting.
onboarding.sent: Link sent. Check your inbox to finish.
onboarding.failed: Sign-up failed. Your code may already have been used.
onboarding.noAnswers: Your answers are not in this browser.
onboarding.noAnswersBody: The sign-in link has to be opened on the same device and browser where you filled in the steps. Start them again here — it is quick.
onboarding.failedBody: Your code may already have been used, or it expired. Ask your coach for a new one.

today.title: Today
today.noneHint: Your coach will send one; it shows up here.

editor.assignLede: Pushing makes the week visible. Nothing leaves without it.
editor.noClients: No clients to push to yet.
editor.pickWeek: Pick a programme on the left.

soonCopy.foods: Nutrition is not in v1: the coach writes targets as text in the programme.
soonCopy.inbox: Messaging is in development. Until it ships, WhatsApp stays where it is.
soonCopy.billing: Billing arrives in v1.1. At this scale a spreadsheet suffices — and nothing will ever be charged automatically.

admin.title: Administration
admin.lede: Platform view. Every read of client data is logged and needs a reason.
admin.logEmpty: No access recorded. That is the right state.
admin.noAccess: This page is for platform administrators only.

checkin.title: Weekly check-in
checkin.lede: You ask on WhatsApp, you type it here. The client-submitted form comes later.

remove.confirmBody: Her record, sessions, check-ins and cycle data are deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
remove.confirmType: Type her first name to confirm

log.title: Session
log.heldCount: {count, plural, =1 {1 set held} other {# sets held}}
log.offline: Offline — your sets are kept here

entry.title: Entry
entry.cyclePromise: Only these two values are sent. Your symptom notes stay on this device.
entry.symptomHint: Never sent. There is no table that could receive it.
entry.healthNote: Sleep and steps come from Health. Quality stays yours, and your cycle is never read.

foods.title: Foods
foods.lede: Your library. Macros are typed per 100 g; calories are derived — never both.
foods.noMatch: Nothing matches “{query}”. “New food” adds it to the database.
foods.pickFood: Pick a food on the left.
foods.emptyHint: Add what your clients eat often — you only type it once.
foods.name: Name
foods.servingNote: The weight is optional: it is what lets a plan offer the serving in one tap.
foods.calculatedNote: Derived from the macros — you never type calories twice.
foods.splitNote: The bar is the calorie split, not the gram split — a gram of fat weighs nine.
foods.usageClients: Clients who see it in a plan
foods.usageNote: Edit the macros here and every plan that uses it follows.
foods.confirmRemoveBody: Meals already logged keep their figures: only the library entry goes.

meals.title: Today's meals
meals.name: Food
meals.noFood: Your coach has no foods in their library yet.

billing.title: Billing
billing.lede: A ledger you tick. Nothing is ever charged automatically — you take payment outside the app.
billing.subOpen: {recurring} recurring · {count, plural, =1 {1 payment still open} other {# payments still open}} ({owed})
billing.subSettled: {recurring} recurring · everyone is settled this month
billing.filterEmpty: Nothing in this filter — everyone here is paid up.
billing.monthlyClients: {count, plural, =0 {no monthly clients} =1 {1 monthly client} other {# monthly clients}}
billing.footShown: {shown} of {total} shown · tick the box to mark a month paid
billing.amountNoteMonthly: Charged every month on the {day}. Agree the change with them before you save it.
billing.amountNotePack: One payment for the whole pack. Split it however you agreed.
billing.billedOn: billed on the {day} of each month
billing.dayNote: Moving the day is a conversation — tell them before you change it.
billing.packNote: When the pack runs out Masse tells you, and nothing renews on its own.
billing.reminderBody:
Hi,

A quick reminder for {month}: {amount}.

Thank you!
billing.nothingAutomaticBody: Masse never charges a card. It tracks what you agreed, tells you what is open, and writes the invoice — you stay the one who asks.
billing.noClients: Add a client before you invoice.

programme.confirmBody: Every week, session and exercise goes, along with the assignments pointing at them. This cannot be undone.
programme.confirmType: Type the programme name to confirm
programme.retractHint: Makes the week invisible to this client again

allowlist.title: Allowed coaches
allowlist.lede: Only these addresses can open a coach account. Clients come in by invite code, not through here.
allowlist.empty: No allowed addresses — nobody can become a coach.

history.title: History
history.noCompare: Only one week so far — nothing to compare.

cycleTab.none: Cycle tracking is not enabled for this client.
cycleTab.promise: You see the phase and the adapted load. Period dates and symptom notes are never shown to you — the database refuses them, this is not the interface hiding them.

stepsTab.seesTarget: {first} sees the target, never a streak to break.

foodSearch.title: Search Open Food Facts
foodSearch.lede: Open, French, no key needed. MyFitnessPal closed its public API in 2019 — there is nothing to connect there.
foodSearch.none: No results. You can still type it in by hand.

library.title: Movements
library.lede: Drag one into a day, or pick the day with ＋.
library.deleteBody: “{name}” is yours: it goes for good. Sessions already written keep their name.
library.hideBody: “{name}” is part of the shared catalogue. It leaves your list only, and you can put it back.

compare.noHistory: Not enough weeks yet to compare.

photos.title: Photos
photos.hint: Stored privately, visible only to her and you.

offline.title: No connection
offline.lede: Masse needs the network to load your sessions.
offline.held: Sets you logged offline are kept on this device. They go as soon as the connection returns — you have nothing to do.

review.discipline: Same light, same time of day — shot before breakfast. Tap a pose to switch both sides.
review.noBaseline: No baseline for this pose yet.
review.qFeel: How did the week feel overall?
review.askRemovePhoto: Delete this photo? It does not come back.

hist.perWeekNote: One bar per week, red where a session was missed. {logged} of {prescribed} prescribed sessions logged.
hist.noStrength: No loaded sets yet to estimate progress from.

cyc.lede: {first} logs the period; the plan adjusts by phase. Symptom notes stay private.
cyc.off: Cycle tracking is not enabled for this client.
cyc.noPhase: No cycle data — nothing to adjust yet.
cyc.promise: You see the phase and the levers you set. Period dates are never shown to you: the database refuses them, this is not the interface hiding them.

nut.noteMacros: {first} sees targets and logs against them. Best for clients who can judge portions.
nut.notePlan: {first} sees the exact meals you wrote. Best for clients who want no decisions.
nut.drift: The macros do not land on the target — {gap} kcal out.
nut.mealsCount: {count, plural, =0 {no meals} =1 {1 meal a day} other {# meals a day}}
nut.noMeals: No meals set. Add them to give her day a shape.
nut.offPlanNote: Logged by her, not by you. If it keeps appearing, write it into the plan.
nut.planEmpty: Add foods to the meals: calories and macros are computed from them.
nut.planDerived: Computed from the plan's foods and supplements.
nut.foodAsksNote: Estimated by the client because the food is not in your database. Add it and every future log uses your numbers instead of a guess.

nutWeek.title: This week
nutWeek.note: Today {today} of {target} so far. {full, plural, =0 {No full day} =1 {1 full day} other {# full days}} landed within 300 kcal of target.

foods2.derived: Derived from the macros — you never type calories twice.
foods2.label: label value
foods2.hint: Type the macros; calories are derived.

nutRead.noFull: No full day logged yet this week.
nutRead.shortMany: {count} full days under by 300 kcal or more ({days}) — {first} is under-fuelling, not over-eating.
nutRead.shortOne: {day} came in {gap} kcal under; the other full days held.
nutRead.over: {count, plural, =1 {1 full day} other {# full days}} over by 300 kcal or more ({days}) — worth asking before adjusting the plan.
nutRead.allNear: Every full day landed within 300 kcal of target.

company.title: My company
company.lede: What a French invoice has to carry. Filled in once here, read by every invoice. Masse checks none of it against a registry: it prints what you write.
company.rcsHint: For companies. A sole trader leaves this empty.
company.franchiseHint: The invoice will carry “TVA non applicable, art. 293 B du CGI” and no VAT amount.
company.assujettiHint: The intra-community VAT number becomes mandatory on the invoice.
company.latePenaltyHint: Mandatory mention. The statutory rate applies if you leave it out.
company.latePenaltyPlaceholder: Three times the statutory interest rate
company.recoveryFeeHint: €40 between businesses. Not applicable to a private individual.
company.prefixHint: Numbering must be continuous, with no gaps.
company.disclaimer: Masse is not legal or accounting advice. Have your accountant check a first invoice before you send it.
company.incomplete: Fill in your company under Admin before you can write an invoice.

invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.defaultPenalty: Late payment penalties: the statutory interest rate in force.
invoice.failed: Issuing failed. Try again, or check your company under Admin.
invoice.mailerOff: Email sending is not configured. Download the PDF and attach it yourself.
invoice.mailBody:
Hi {name},

Here is the invoice for {month}: {amount}.
It is attached.

Thank you,
{coach}
invoice.noAddress: This client has no email address on file.
invoice.sendFailed: Sending failed. The PDF is still downloadable.

hevy.notConfigured: Hevy import is not configured. It needs a Pro API key in HEVY_API_KEY — get it at hevy.com/settings?developer, on the web app rather than the phone.

error.unauthorised: Hevy refused the key. Check it is valid and the account is Pro.
error.failed: The import failed. Try again in a moment.

dayTypes.title: day types
dayTypes.lede: A leg day is not eaten like an off day. Name your types, give each its targets — and {first} carries the right plan even when the week moves.
dayTypes.name: Type name
dayTypes.weekNote: Change a day here and what is eaten that day changes. {first} can move her off days from her phone: the plan follows the type, not the weekday.
dayTypes.deleteBody: “{name}” goes with its targets and its meals — they describe that day and nothing else. Days that carried it fall back to the default plan.

myWeek.title: Your week
myWeek.lede: Tap one day, then another, to swap them.
myWeek.pickSecond: {day} selected. Tap the day to swap it with.
myWeek.note: Your food follows the kind of day, not the weekday: move one and the right plan moves with you. Your coach sees it.

supp.title: Supplements
supp.lede: Doses are ranges, because that is how they are actually known. The note says what a label will not.
supp.unusableWhy: Masse will not put it in a plan. It stays here to answer the question rather than leave it open.
supp.name: Name
supp.deleteBody: Delete “{name}” from your library? Protocols already written keep their dose.
supp.hideBody: “{name}” is built in: it belongs to everyone. You can hide it from your own library — reversible, and nobody else's list changes.

proto.title: Supplements
proto.lede: What {first} takes, and when. Anything carrying macros counts in the day's total.
proto.inTotal: {kcal} kcal and {protein} g of protein come from supplements.
proto.refused: “{name}” is marked not usable: it cannot be prescribed.
proto.macrosLost: Macros not counted: the known density is per {unit}.

fuel.empty: Your coach hasn't written a plan for you yet.

bilan.title: Your check-in
bilan.lede: Once a week. Your coach reads it before writing what comes next.
bilan.prompt: This week's check-in isn't filled in yet.
bilan.byCoach: Your coach has already filed this week's check-in.
bilan.discipline: Same light, same time of day — shot before breakfast. Tap a pose to switch both sides.

stepsChart.title: Your steps
stepsChart.noTarget: Your coach hasn't set a step target.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dailyHint: Every day, to note your sleep and steps.
settings.weeklyHint: Sundays at 6 pm, to fill in your weekly check-in.
settings.denied: Notifications are off for Masse. Turn them back on in iPhone Settings.
settings.webReminders: Reminders live in the iPhone app. On the web, the browser cannot schedule them.
settings.healthOn: Connected · sleep and steps, read only
settings.healthManage: Permissions are changed in Settings › Health › Data Access.
settings.languageHint: Masse follows your iPhone’s language. To change it for Masse only: Settings › Masse › Language.
settings.languageWeb: The app’s language, on this device.
settings.privacyNotes: Your symptom notes stay on this device. No table can receive them.
settings.privacyCoach: Your coach sees your sessions, your daily log, your check-ins and, if you turned it on, your cycle dates.
settings.clearConfirm: Erase all your notes? They exist nowhere else.
settings.emergencyHint: A name and a number, just in case.
settings.emailFixed: Your address is how you sign in. To change it, ask your coach.
settings.profileLede: Your coach sees these details on your file.
settings.billingLede: What you agreed with your coach, and what has been settled. The app charges nothing: you pay your coach directly.
settings.noPlan: Your coach has not recorded a plan yet.
settings.pdfFailed: The invoice could not be opened.
